tools.name: get_exchange_rate
tools.description: Returns the current mid-market exchange rate between two currencies as the number of units of to_currency per one unit of from_currency, with the time it was read. Use it to answer how much one currency is worth in another. It does not say whether Morse can send money in either currency; use list_se

tools.name: list_send_destinations
tools.description: Returns the countries, currencies and payment rails a person living in from_country can send money to with Morse when paying someone else's bank account, with the typical delivery time for each. Use it to answer whether Morse can send from one country to another. An empty destinations list means sen

tools.name: quote_send
tools.description: Returns an indicative quote for sending money with Morse from a person living in from_country to someone else's bank account in to_country: the amount sent, the fee, the mid-market exchange rate and what the recipient gets. The result includes the total cost of the transfer and the typical delivery
